description: "Lady Clare" by Baron Alfred Tennyson Tennyson is a narrative poem first published in 1842. It tells the story of Lady Clare, a young noblewoman about to marry her cousin Lord Ronald, when her nurse reveals a shocking secret: she is not truly noble-born but was switched at birth with the real Lady Clare who died in infancy.
